title: Phoenix Sights & Stories Sunset Tour: Downtown & Papago Park
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the vibrant culture and history of Phoenix on this engaging tour led by a local expert. Take a ride through downtown in a comfortable air conditioned van as your guide shares fascinating stories about the landmarks and neighborhoods along the way. You'll stop for an easy walk at the memorial by the Arizona State Capitol and a shot stop outside the George Washington Carver Museum before heading to Papago Park for the sunset views. This experience emphasizes small group sizes and conversation so you can engage with your guide and fellow travelers about the city’s heritage and ecology. Get a personalized glimpse into the heart of Phoenix, ensuring you leave with a deeper understanding of its past and present.

- 3 hour guided tour of key landmarks around Downtown Phoenix
- Your local geographer-guide provides rich storytelling
- Small group experience (up to 8 guests) for personalized interaction and attention
- Experience the incredible sunset view at Hunt’s Tomb in Papago Park
